description: IP Australia trade mark records by trade mark number from the IPGOD open data table on data.gov.au (2017 edition, marked superseded): status, live or dead, mark type, lodgement and registration dates, Madrid indicator. Applicant names are not in this table. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_tmview_trademarks when you need EU trade mark search on EUIPO's official Trademark Search; gov_australia_data_gov_au when you need Australian government open datasets from data.gov.au. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
